FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.AlarmU01_js: Matomo's JavaScript tracker cannot be loaded from the Matomo server since %1$s (%2$s).
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.AlarmU01_tracker: Matomo's tracker endpoint cannot be reached from the Matomo server since %1$s (%2$s). Tracking data may be lost.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.AlarmU01_ui: The Matomo interface cannot be reached from the Matomo server since %1$s (%2$s).
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.AlarmU02_container: The Tag Manager container %1$s cannot be loaded since %2$s (%3$s).
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.AlarmU02_proxy: The tracking proxy on %1$s does not deliver Matomo's tracker since %2$s (%3$s).
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.AlarmU02_web: The website %1$s cannot be reached from the Matomo server since %2$s (%3$s).
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.AlarmU03: The TLS certificate of %1$s expires on %2$s (in %3$s days).
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.AlarmU03Expired: The TLS certificate of %1$s expired on %2$s.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.AlarmU04: Matomo's tracker is slow: %1$s ms median in the last hour (threshold %2$s ms).
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.CheckU01Description: Matomo's interface, tracker endpoint or JavaScript tracker cannot be reached from the Matomo server (Feinwerk Uptime Monitor).
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.CheckU02Description: The website, one of its Tag Manager containers or its tracking proxy cannot be reached from the Matomo server (Feinwerk Uptime Monitor).
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.CheckU03Description: A TLS certificate of Matomo or of the website expires soon or has expired (Feinwerk Uptime Monitor).
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.CheckU04Description: Matomo needed longer than the threshold to process tracking requests in the last hour (Feinwerk Uptime Monitor).
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.ConnectorInstallerActivateText: The connector is already installed but not activated yet.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.ConnectorInstallerClickAgain: For your security Matomo checked this step once more. Please click the button again.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.ConnectorInstallerConsole: The connector is already installed, but plugin administration is switched off in this Matomo. Activate it on the command line:
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.ConnectorInstallerInstallText: Matomo downloads the connector from its Marketplace, installs it and then activates it.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.ConnectorInstallerIntro: With the free Feinwerk Connector you install, update and license Feinwerk plugins right inside Matomo.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.ConnectorInstallerManual: This Matomo cannot install plugins from its Marketplace by itself. To install the connector by hand:
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.ConnectorInstallerManualStep2: Unzip it and put the folder %s into the plugins directory of your Matomo.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.ConnectorInstallerManualStep3: Activate the connector under Administration, Plugins.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.ConnectorInstallerManualStep3Console: Plugin administration is switched off in this Matomo, so activate the connector on the command line:
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.ConnectorInstallerPasswordNote: As with every plugin install, Matomo first asks for your password if you have not entered it recently.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.ConnectorInstallerPhp: The Feinwerk Connector needs PHP %s or newer. Once your server runs it, you can install the connector here.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.ConnectorInstallerWordPress: In Matomo for WordPress the Feinwerk Connector is installed as a WordPress plugin: open Matomo Analytics, Marketplace in WordPress and search for Feinwerk.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.ErrorCheckNowTooSoon: These targets were checked less than a minute ago. Please try again in %1$s seconds.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.ErrorDefaultTarget: The target '%1$s' comes from Matomo and returns at the next check. Switch it off with updateTarget and enabled=0 instead.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.ErrorHost: Please enter a host name only, without https:// and without a path.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.ErrorNoMainUrl: This website has no address to read the tracking code from.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.ErrorParameterNotAllowed: The parameter '%1$s' does not accept '%2$s'. Allowed: %3$s.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.ErrorParameterRange: The parameter '%1$s' must be a whole number from %3$s to %4$s, not '%2$s'.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.ErrorPeriodTooLong: The parameter '%1$s' allows at most %2$s days here; please choose a shorter period.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.ErrorRange: Please enter a whole number from %1$s to %2$s.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.ErrorSiteUnknown: There is no website with the ID '%1$s'.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.ErrorTargetLimit: A website can have at most %1$s website addresses.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.ErrorTargetUnknown: There is no target '%1$s' for this website. getTargets lists the targets.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.ErrorUrl: Please enter an address that starts with http:// or https://.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.FeedbackQuestion_page: Does the uptime page show Matomo and your website correctly?
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.FeedbackThanksDown: Thank you. If you like, describe the problem to our support.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.Help: Whether Matomo itself and this website are reachable, checked from the Matomo server: uptime, response times, outages and certificate expiry. Time without any check counts as not measured, never as reachable.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.HintSiteDown: Feinwerk Uptime Monitor: the website or its tracking cannot be reached from the Matomo server since %1$s.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.PremiumAskSuperUser: Your Matomo super user can install it.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.PromoCampaignsInstallText: The free plugin Feinwerk Campaign Manager builds clean campaign links right in Matomo and shows visits and conversions per campaign.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.PromoCampaignsOpenText: Feinwerk Campaign Manager is installed: create campaign links and see visits and conversions per campaign.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.PromoCampaignsText: UTM builder and naming conventions for your team, so that campaigns arrive in Matomo cleanly.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.PromoCapiText: Feinwerk Conversions API sends orders and goals from Matomo server-side to Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, X and Microsoft Advertising, only with consent and without ad pixels on your website.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.PromoConnectorLink: Install the Feinwerk Connector from the Matomo Marketplace
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.PromoConnectorText: Exclusive Plugins for Matomo by Feinwerk, free, freemium and premium:
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.PromoHostingText: Feinwerk runs your Matomo instance in German data centers, with updates, backups and monitoring, and the move is included.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.PromoSentinelText: The free plugin Feinwerk Sentinel watches your Matomo data around the clock and alerts you by email, Slack or Teams as soon as goals stop or tracking breaks.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.SettingAllowPrivateHelp: Off by default: the checks reach public addresses only, so that no one can use them to look into your internal network. When it is on, the admins of every website can have the Matomo server request addresses in your internal network: switch it on only for a Matomo or websites in an intranet.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.SettingCertWarningHelp: A warning this many days before a TLS certificate expires; 3 days before, the warning becomes critical. Default 14.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.SettingLoginHostHelp: Only if Matomo sends visitors who are not logged in to another host to sign in (single sign-on): that host name, for example login.example.com. The Matomo interface then counts as reachable when it forwards there.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.SettingSlowTrackerHelp: The tracker counts as slow when the median processing time of the last hour is above this value. Default 1000.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.SettingTrackerBaseHelp: Only if tracking runs on another address than this Matomo, for example a separate tracking host or a CDN: the address under which matomo.php and matomo.js are reachable. Empty: the Matomo address.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.SupportTitle: Opens the Feinwerk contact form in a new tab
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.UiAdminContainersDown: Tag Manager container of %s not reachable
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.UiAdminContainersDownMany: Tag Manager containers of %s websites not reachable
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.UiAdminIntro: Matomo and every website with check targets. The checks run from this server; Checks and alerts below shows how often.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.UiAdminNotCheckableHelp: The Matomo server cannot reach the addresses of these websites itself, for example because of a firewall, a private address or a router that does not route requests back into its own network, or the addresses ask for a password or block automated requests. This is not counted as an outage.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.UiAdminNotCheckableMany: %s websites cannot be checked from this server and do not count as outages.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.UiAdminNotCheckableNamedMany: %s cannot be checked from this server and do not count as outages.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.UiAdminNotCheckableNamedOne: %s cannot be checked from this server and does not count as an outage.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.UiAllOffMatomo: No address of Matomo itself is checked. Super users switch them on under Administration, Diagnostic, Uptime Monitor.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.UiAllOffSite: No address of this website is checked. Admins of the website switch one on with Edit check targets.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.UiCheckBusy: Another check is running. Please try again in a minute.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.UiCronActiveMinute: The checks run every minute (system cron).
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.UiCronHelp: Without a cron of its own, the checks run with Matomo's hourly tasks, and alerts can come up to two hours late. For checks every minute, add this line to the cron of the Matomo server (as the user that runs Matomo's other cron jobs).
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.UiEndpointTime: Tracker endpoint response time per hour (median)
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.UiFirstCheck: No check yet. The first check runs within the hour.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.UiGap: No measurement: Matomo or its cron was not running
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.UiLoadFailed: The uptime data could not be loaded.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.UiNotCheckableHelp: The Matomo server cannot reach this address itself, for example because of a firewall, a private address or a router that does not route requests back into its own network, or the address asks for a password or blocks automated requests. This is not counted as an outage.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.UiNotCheckableMany: %s addresses cannot be checked from this server and do not count as outages.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.UiNotCheckableOne: 1 address cannot be checked from this server and does not count as an outage.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.UiNotCheckableSettings: Super users can allow private addresses in the settings.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.UiQueuedTracking: QueuedTracking is active: this is the time until a request is queued, not until it is processed.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.UiRemoveConfirm: Remove %s? Its uptime history disappears from this page.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.UiRequestFailed: The request did not go through. Please try again.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.UiSentinelActive: Feinwerk Sentinel sends the alerts: by e-mail, Slack or Teams when Matomo or a website is down, a certificate expires or the tracker is slow.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.UiSentinelFacts: Alerts about Matomo itself go to the super users chosen in %1$sSentinel's settings%2$s, to its instance e-mail addresses and its instance webhook; if none of these is set, they reach nobody. Matomo cannot report its own complete outage: those hours show as not measured.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.UiSentinelInactive: No alerts: Feinwerk Sentinel is installed but not activated. Activate it under Administration, Plugins, and outages, expiring certificates and a slow tracker are reported by e-mail, Slack or Teams.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.UiSentinelMissing: No alerts: Feinwerk Sentinel is not installed. With the free plugin, outages, expiring certificates and a slow tracker are reported by e-mail, Slack or Teams.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.UiSentinelOld: No alerts: Feinwerk Sentinel %s is too old for this plugin's alerts. Update it to 5.0.0 or newer under Administration, Plugins.
FeinwerkUptimeMonitor.UiSuggestions: Found on the website, not adopted
